chunks: Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'When one of you is brought the basil, let him smell it and let him place it upon his eyes, for it is from Paradise.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical benefit of basil according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), linking the sensory pleasure of basil (*rayhan*) to its eschatological origin in Paradise. This reflects the Shia tradition of finding spiritual resonance in natural creation, where the scent of basil serves as a tangible reminder of the bliss of the hereafter and the purity of the soul.
